hermesCc.label: Hermes·CC providers
hermesCc.description: Add Hermes·CC versions of configured Hermes ACP providers to save pasted prompt images in Clear Chat. Reload the host to apply.
hermesCc.error: Could not load or save the Hermes·CC setting.

settings.title: Chat presentation
settings.intro: Changes are saved on the selected host and shared by its clients. New messages follow rendering changes; reload the chat to update existing messages. Accent colours update immediately.

accent.label: Accent colour
accent.description: Use the current Paseo theme, or choose a presentation accent.
accent.hexHint: Enter #RGB or #RRGGBB, then apply the colour.
accent.invalid: Enter a HEX colour as #RGB or #RRGGBB.
accent.contrastHelp: The saved HEX stays unchanged. For readable text, we darken it on light themes or lighten it on dark themes until contrast is at least 4.5:1 on plugin surfaces. Filled buttons use black or white text, whichever has higher contrast. Midtone themes may use solid backgrounds to keep that contrast.

uiFont.label: Interface font
uiFont.description: Choose the embedded Inter face or the system interface face.

codeGlyphs.label: Code glyphs
codeGlyphs.description: For Iosevka, use programming ligatures inside syntax blocks or keep glyphs literal. Other fonts use their own glyphs.

codeFont.label: Code font
codeFont.description: Paseo's code font is not exposed by the plugin SDK. Default (Iosevka) uses Iosevka and your Code glyphs choice. Other fonts must be installed on web or desktop; missing fonts use Iosevka. iOS and Android use platform monospace.

textSize.label: Text size
textSize.description: Scales the text this plugin draws, from replies and code blocks to callouts and badges. Saved on this host for all your devices.

foldSteps.label: Fold finished steps
foldSteps.description: Collapse finished tool calls by default. Turning this off expands every step. Saved choices for individual calls take precedence.

collapsedAction.label: When a collapsed step is pressed
collapsedAction.description: Open a detail sheet, popover or side panel, or expand the card in the conversation.

foldOutput.label: Fold long output after
foldOutput.description: Preview long tool output, reply code and prompts with a button to reveal every line.

frosted.label: Frosted glass
frosted.description: Blur surfaces where the host supports it, or use solid surfaces instead.

glow.label: Pointer glow
glow.description: A soft light follows the pointer across each card. Desktop and web only: touch platforms have no hover, and the light is skipped when the system asks for reduced motion.

promptBubble.label: Enhanced prompt bubble
promptBubble.description: Styles your prompts. Pasted images show as thumbnails for Codex, Claude and Hermes·CC agents; for other Hermes agents, turn this off to see them in Paseo's own bubble. New prompts follow the change. On iOS, text cannot be selected by dragging when this is enabled. Use the Copy button to copy text.

selection.label: Selection actions
selection.description: Highlighting text in a callout raises a small bar with Copy and Add to chat. Add to chat drops the highlight into the composer as a quote, or a fenced block when it came from code. Desktop and web only: iOS and Android use the platform's own selection menu.

markdown.label: Assistant markdown
markdown.description: Draws the reply with the plugin's own headings, lists and syntax-highlighted code blocks. The plugin cannot reach Paseo's markdown pipeline, so its version is a subset: turn this off for mermaid diagrams, images, and the host's file-path links. On iOS, text cannot be selected by dragging when this is enabled. Use the Copy button to copy text.

markdownStyle.label: Markdown style
markdownStyle.description: Document is airy and built for long answers. Compact tightens the spacing for short replies. Terminal sets the body in the code face.

startup.incompatibleHost: Clear Chat requires Paseo plugin settings and timeline support. Update Paseo on the daemon host and all connected apps, then reload Clear Chat.
startup.startupFailed: Clear Chat could not start because Paseo could not register the plugin. Update Paseo and reload Clear Chat. If it still fails, back up the plugin settings before reinstalling with the Paseo CLI.
startup.settingsRead: Clear Chat cannot read its host settings. Reconnect to the selected host, then select Retry. If it still fails, check the daemon's access to the plugin settings folder.
startup.settingsInvalid: Clear Chat settings are invalid or use an unsupported format. Back up the plugin settings, restore a valid backup or repair the settings file on the daemon host, then select Retry.
startup.settingsWrite: Clear Chat cannot save its host settings. Check the daemon's write access and available disk space, reconnect, then try the setting again.
startup.settingsConflict: Clear Chat settings keep changing in another client. Wait for other edits to finish, then try the setting again.
